viewer.cmd.n.modular: Modular mode: the command writes <page>.html (shell), <page>.glb, <page>.config.json and the shared lib/three-0.160.0/ folder. Publish them together and open the page over http/https. To change only one setting afterwards: run the same command again with --config-only -o <page>.html (the .glb and the shell are not touched; visitors reload). The viewer can also export this structure: “Export the modular structure (.zip)” button.

The coordinates (zones, target, sea hole) are those of the original model, usable as they are. An already generated page is updated with the same command.
